breaking_changes: Express 4.9/body-parser 1.9 to Express 5/body-parser 2 changes route matching, middleware behavior, and error-handling expectations.
MongoDB driver 2.x to 7.x removes legacy callback-era APIs and changes connection/client patterns.
Socket.IO 1.1 to 4.x changes protocol compatibility, server/client APIs, middleware/auth behavior, and requires coordinated client/server upgrade.
jsonwebtoken 5.x to 9.x has stricter algorithm/key handling and callback/sign/verify behavior changes.
sharp 0.14 to 0.35 spans native binary, Node ABI, and image pipeline API changes.
winston 1.x and winston-logstash 0.3 to current versions change transport APIs and logger construction.
nodemailer 1.x to 9.x changes transport and message APIs; old direct transport patterns may break.
uuid 2.x to 14.x removes legacy default require call patterns in favor of named APIs/modern module behavior.
csv 0.4 to 6.x, archiver 0.14 to 8.x, and xmlbuilder 2.x to 15.x include major API shifts.
request, fluent-ffmpeg, and gc-stats are deprecated or unsupported, so replacement or containment decisions are likely needed.
risk_summary.notes: Primary language JavaScript/Node.js. Package manager appears to be npm via package.json manifests; no lockfiles or npm scripts were found in the repository scan. Entry points include tv-radio-admin/Admin/API/app.js, tv-radio-admin/CLI/chapman.js, tv-radio-admin/CLI/backup.js, tv-radio-admin/Utilities/ember-precompile.js, tv-radio-frontend/app.js, and tv-radio-frontend/app-media.js. Test commands were not declared in package manifests.
